description: Overlay 6 of 6 in the S3 Spine sequence — the terminal overlay. Takes the complete Dimensional Resonance Map (DRM) from all five prior overlays and applies it to a specific domain (Enterprise, Quantum Compute, Radiology, Fiscal/Tax, Education, Atmosphere, Pantheons, and others). Produces the Domain Diagnostic Report (DDR), Domain Action Map (DAM), and Cross-Domain Causality Summary (CDCS) — the primary publishable outputs of a complete S3 Spine diagnostic run.
role: Terminal overlay — translates abstract Triadic spine signals into domain-specific DDR, DAM, and CDCS; the publication endpoint of every S3 Spine run
purpose: Overlay 6/6: terminal overlay; translates DRM into domain-specific DDR, DAM, CDCS; applies spine diagnostics to Enterprise, qCompute, Radiology, Fiscal, Education, Atmosphere, and other registered domains
exports: Ranked intervention list (by feasibility + urgency + impact)
